# skip refitting a model if we already have a saved result on disk.

```{r}
cache_dir <- "cache_traffic"
if (!dir.exists(cache_dir)) dir.create(cache_dir)

# run_cached(path, fun): if `path` already exists, load and return it;
# otherwise run fun(), save the result to `path`, and return it.
run_cached <- function(path, fun) {
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    message("[cache hit]  loading ", path)
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    message("[cache miss] computing ", path)
    result <- fun()
    saveRDS(result, path)
    result
  }
}

```

# Msarima - using auto.msarima() from smooth package

```{r}

time_auto <- system.time({

  fit_auto <- auto.msarima(
    x_detrend,
    lags = c(1, 24, 168),

    orders = list(
      ar = c(2, 2, 2),
      i  = c(1, 0, 0),
      ma = c(2, 2, 2)
    ),

    initial = "backcasting",
    bounds  = "admissible",
    loss    = "likelihood",
    ic      = "BIC",
    silent  = TRUE
  )

})

### OBS! I get the same fit as in the paper with the paper
orders(fit_auto)
lags(fit_auto)
modelName(fit_auto)
BIC(fit_auto)

#summary(fit_auto)
coef(fit_auto)
cat("auto.msarima() selected:", fit_auto$model, "\n")# SARIMA(0,1,2)[1](1,0,2)[24](2,0,2)[168] 

time_auto["elapsed"]/60 # actual time elapsed in seconds
#4.76 mins
```

  x_detrend,

)

### Prophet

```{r}
# Additive model: Y_t = T_t + S_t + H_t + ε_t
# Trend + Fourier seasonality + holidays + noise
# Requires specific dataframe format: ds (datetime) + y (value)

library(prophet)

library(prophet)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prophet data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

prophet_train <- data.frame(
  ds = energy_raw$timestamp,
  y  = as.numeric(x_detrend)
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Define Prophet model WITHOUT fitting
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fit_prophet <- prophet(
  daily.seasonality  = FALSE,
  weekly.seasonality = FALSE,
  yearly.seasonality = FALSE,
  seasonality.mode   = "additive"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Add seasonalities
#
# Prophet periods are expressed in DAYS:
#   24 hours  = 1 day
#   168 hours = 7 days
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fit_prophet <- add_seasonality(
  fit_prophet,
  name = "daily",
  period = 1,
  fourier.order = 10
)

fit_prophet <- add_seasonality(
  fit_prophet,
  name = "weekly",
  period = 7,
  fourier.order = 3
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit model
# ------------------------------------------------------------

time_prophet <- system.time({

  fit_prophet <- fit.prophet(
    fit_prophet,
    prophet_train
  )

})

cat("Fitting time:", time_prophet["elapsed"], "seconds\n")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# In-sample fitted values
# ------------------------------------------------------------

prophet_fitted <- predict(
  fit_prophet,
  prophet_train
)

fitted_prophet <- prophet_fitted$yhat


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# MAE and RMSE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

mae_prophet <- mean(
  abs(x_detrend - fitted_prophet),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

rmse_prophet <- sqrt(
  mean((x_detrend - fitted_prophet)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
)

cat("MAE: ", mae_prophet, "\n")
cat("RMSE:", rmse_prophet, "\n")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Residual ACF
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resid_prophet <- as.numeric(x_detrend) - fitted_prophet

acf(
  resid_prophet,
  lag.max = 24 * 14,
  main = "Prophet Residual ACF"
)

# Daily seasonal lags
abline(
  v = seq(24, 24 * 14, by = 24),
  col = "indianred",
  lty = 2
)

# Weekly seasonal lags
abline(
  v = seq(168, 24 * 14, by = 168),
  col = "darkblue",
  lty = 2
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Decomposition
# ------------------------------------------------------------

prophet_plot_components(
  fit_prophet,
  prophet_fitted
)
### 20.94 seconds - fast
```


# TBATS
```{r}
library(forecast)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create multiple-seasonal hourly time series
# Daily seasonality:  24
# Weekly seasonality: 168
# ------------------------------------------------------------

y_train_msts <- msts(
  x_detrend,
  seasonal.periods = c(24, 168)
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit TBATS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

time_tbats <- system.time({

  fit_tbats <- tbats(
    y_train_msts,
    use.box.cox      = NULL,
    use.trend        = NULL,
    use.damped.trend = NULL,
    seasonal.periods = c(24, 168)
  )

})

cat("Fitting time:", time_tbats["elapsed"]/60, "mins\n") #8.851667 mins

print(fit_tbats)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Residual ACF
# ------------------------------------------------------------

resid_tbats <- as.numeric(residuals(fit_tbats))

acf(
  resid_tbats,
  lag.max = 24 * 14,
  main = "TBATS Residual ACF"
)

# Daily seasonal lags
abline(
  v = seq(24, 24 * 14, by = 24),
  col = "indianred",
  lty = 2
)

# Weekly seasonal lags
abline(
  v = seq(168, 24 * 14, by = 168),
  col = "darkblue",
  lty = 2
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# In-sample fitted values
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fitted_tbats <- as.numeric(fitted(fit_tbats))


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# In-sample MAE and RMSE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

mae_tbats <- mean(
  abs(as.numeric(x_detrend) - fitted_tbats),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

rmse_tbats <- sqrt(
  mean((as.numeric(x_detrend) - fitted_tbats)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
)

cat("TBATS MAE: ", mae_tbats, "\n")
cat("TBATS RMSE:", rmse_tbats, "\n")
```

# EXPAND WINDOW METHOD

## 3024 refits, one per 10-min observation

```{r}
# ── Coverage & interval width ────────────────────────
# actual, lower, upper are all (n_test x h) matrices, same shape as
# Coverage = proportion of actual values falling inside [lower bound, upper bound]
# Width    = average interval size (upper bound - lower bound)

coverage_width <- function(actual, lower, upper) {
  covered <- (actual >= lower) & (actual <= upper)
  list(
    coverage_overall = mean(covered, na.rm = TRUE),
    width_overall    = mean(upper - lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    coverage_by_h    = colMeans(covered, na.rm = TRUE),   # for the h vs coverage plot
    width_by_h       = colMeans(upper - lower, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
```

## mSARIMA

```{r}

## restart cleanely
library(future)

plan(sequential)

plan(multisession, workers = 4)

## Test
library(future.apply)

#file.create(file.path(tempdir(), "test.txt"))
# Parallelized: each of the 2736 origins is independent, so future_lapply()
# runs them concurrently across cores instead of one at a time. Same model,
# NOTE: smooth's forecast() level is a PROPORTION (0.95), not a percentage
# msarima's optimizer is deterministic (no random init), so no seed is needed for reproducibilty

library(future.apply)
library(future)

msarima_full_path <- "fc_msarima_full3.RData"

forecast_origins = 100

if (file.exists(msarima_full_path)) {

  message("[cache hit] loading ", msarima_full_path, " — skipping mSARIMA expanding window loop")
  load(msarima_full_path)

} else {

  n_workers <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
  cat("Running mSARIMA FULL expanding window (2736 refits) across",
      n_workers, "workers...\n")

  plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)

  time_msarima_full <- system.time({
    results_msarima <- future_lapply(1:forecast_origins, function(i) {

      train_end_i <- n_train + i - 1
      y_train_i   <- y_full[1:train_end_i]

      tryCatch({
        fit_i <- smooth::msarima(
          y_train_i,
          lags   = c(1, 144, 1008),
          orders = list(
            ar = c(1, 2, 2),
            i  = c(1, 0, 0),
            ma = c(1, 2, 2)
          ),
          silent = TRUE
        )

        fc_i <- forecast::forecast(fit_i, h = h, interval = "parametric", level = 0.95)

        # $lower/$upper may come back as a 1-col matrix or a plain vector
        # depending on smooth's version — as.matrix()[,1] handles either.
        list(
          mean  = as.numeric(fc_i$mean),
          lower = as.numeric(as.matrix(fc_i$lower)[, 1]),
          upper = as.numeric(as.matrix(fc_i$upper)[, 1]),
          ok = TRUE, error = NA_character_
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        list(mean = rep(NA_real_, h), lower = rep(NA_real_, h), upper = rep(NA_real_, h),
             ok = FALSE, error = conditionMessage(e))
      })

    }, future.seed = TRUE)
  })

  plan(sequential)

  fc_msarima_full       <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_msarima, `[[`, "mean"))
  fc_msarima_full_lower <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_msarima, `[[`, "lower"))
  fc_msarima_full_upper <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_msarima, `[[`, "upper"))

  n_failed <- sum(!sapply(results_msarima, `[[`, "ok"))
  if (n_failed > 0) {
    cat(n_failed, "origin(s) failed to fit — filled with NA.\n")
    failed_idx <- which(!sapply(results_msarima, `[[`, "ok"))
    cat("Failed origins:", paste(head(failed_idx, 10), collapse = ", "),
        if (length(failed_idx) > 10) "..." else "", "\n")
  } else {
    cat("All 200 origins fit successfully.\n")
  }

  cat("mSARIMA full loop time:",
      round(time_msarima_full["elapsed"]/60, 2), "minutes\n")

  save(fc_msarima_full, fc_msarima_full_lower, fc_msarima_full_upper,
       file = msarima_full_path)
  cat("mSARIMA full forecasts + 95% PI saved.\n")
}

#fc_msarima_full1 = fc_msarima_full[1:2736,]

#package_version(forecast)
```

  type = "l",
  lwd = 2,
  ylim = c(20, 190),
  xlab = "Forecast horizon",

  msarima_pi$coverage_by_h,
  type = "l",
  lwd = 2,
  ylim = c(0, 1),

  col = "red",
